cases.name: a-mark-in-a-turned-field-is-fitted-into-its-frame
cases.covers: A mark drawn into a signature field turned 90 has a mark, and its rect is its box with the sides swapped.

cases.name: a-turn-turns-the-mark-and-undo-puts-it-back
cases.covers: A turn of a marked widget fits the mark again (appearance changed, the mark kept); Acrobat's Orientation, a new frame, fits it as a new field's; two undos put it back upright.
